systems.system: digitalisation des amendes forfaitaires (Points de Digitalisation des Amendes, PDA)
systems.tiers: 50 PDA installed nationwide in 2024, supported by 47 brigades (29 Police, 18 Gendarmerie); 164,014 fines processed in 2024 (Police 98,074, Gendarmerie 65,940), FCFA 841.9 million collected online; target of 100 PDA in 2025

note: Fixed-penalty traffic fines only, a single function; the document states nothing about occurrence or case records at stations.
